minutes.headline: Finance Committee will draft a checklist for commenting on warrant articles and plan a joint five-year forecast with schools
minutes.summary: Members discussed stormwater costs raised by the Butterfly Lane article, the superintendent's staffing presentation, and how to coordinate a five-year forecast between the town manager and the superintendent. They also covered when the committee should comment on Town Meeting articles, budget terminology, free cash, non-municipal funding, and oversight of collective bargaining. Committee reports followed, and a motion on minutes was made but the result is not in the captions.

A member will circulate a draft checklist for deciding when the committee comments on Town Meeting warrant articles.
The chair will ask the town manager to explain budget terms such as target budget and level service.
Members discussed stormwater maintenance costs tied to the Butterfly Lane article, recalling an estimate given before Town Meeting that differed from the one presented there.

why_it_matters: A joint town and school five-year forecast would show residents how combined costs may affect future tax bills, and a comment checklist would shape what guidance the committee gives before Town Meeting votes.
Questions about free cash, stormwater costs and outside funding bear on how much of the budget depends on one-time money and on estimates given before a vote.
